L1 · Firebox

Drop cloths down before the brush goes up

A sweep removes soot and creosote from the firebox to the cap. The vacuum runs at the opening the whole time.

Dusty soot forms from cool, smoky fires. A sweep removes it cleanly.

Crunchy flakes mean stage-2 creosote. A sweep removes most of it; some may need a second pass.

Shiny glaze is stage-3 creosote. It may need a special treatment or a second visit. We will show you before we quote.

“They put down a drop cloth that went halfway across the living room and ran the vacuum the whole time. When they left, the white rug in front of the hearth was still white.”

Dan P., Missoula · Chimney sweep Sample review
